summary: The S&P Global 1200 Shariah Information Technology Capped Index is designed to measure the performance of global large-cap equity securities within the information technology sector that pass rules-based screens for adherence to Shariah investment guidelines, with a cap applied to ensure diversification among companies in the index. Under normal circumstances, at least 80% of the fund’s total assets will be invested in the component securities of the index. It is non-diversified.
